correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the five-vertex rim+hub wheel, 16 oriented gradient arrows and all admissible acyclic partial arrow sets: face vector (16,94,240,225), 575 nonempty faces. Independently reproduced the prescribed ordered Morse pairing: exactly 255 disjoint pairs and one critical 0-cell plus 64 critical 3-cells, with all 1808 directed Hasse covers forming a DAG. This establishes integral homotopy wedge of 64 three-spheres. Independently computed all 8 dihedral vertex permutations and signed chain traces: identity (16,94,240,225), quarter-turn (0,0,0,-1), half-turn (0,-6,0,5), 2-fixed reflections (4,0,-12,-9), 0-fixed (0,-4,0,3). Lefschetz-Hopf gives degree-three homology character (64,0,0,0,0,0,0,0), so by rational semisimplicity H3=Q[D4]^8. This is an action on rational homology, not equivariant Morse collapse or integral lattice decomposition.
residual_risks: Only this single wheel and rational representation are classified; natural complete homology concentration is verified exactly.
